title: Anomaly Detection
summary: A student project comparing statistical, machine-learning, deep-learning and graph-based approaches to anomaly detection on labeled fraud and network intrusion datasets. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, driven through a Metadata object, to generate synthetic minority-class samples for class-imbalance handling during training.
